To the Holy Spirit, for the inspiration, wisdom, and conviction that made this book possible.

Father, we thank You. Because Your kingdom is come, we now carry it out. We do Your will on earth as it is done in heaven. Matthew 6:10. This we do via the Holy Spirit, not by might nor by power. Romans 8:13. Proving what is acceptable unto You. Ephesians 5:10.

Friends, by every indication the return of our Saviour Jesus Christ is nearer than ever, as written in 1 Corinthians 15:51-52 and 1 Thessalonians 4:16-17. "Listen!" says Jesus, "I am coming soon" (Revelation 22:12 GNT). Many professing Christians are aware of this, yet do not know what they ought to do. Many others remain unaware.
Worse, many churches have abandoned the foundation of the apostles and now operate in error that is another gospel which will ultimately lead to "Had I known" on the last day (Galatians 1:6-9).
But through the revelations of the Holy Spirit in this book, those who are the seed of God — the wise virgins — will read this epistle and come out of error before it is too late.
Jesus said, "My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me" (John 10:27) “
...and a stranger will they not follow" (John 10:5).
He also warned, "Not everyone that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven" (Matthew 7:21).
That is why He commanded us to be watchful against false

prophets and wrong doctrines (Matthew 7:15; 16:6), and Paul warns, "Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall" (1 Corinthians 10:12). Jesus said of the Holy Spirit, "And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment" (John 16:8)
The Holy Spirit explains this and more in this book.
Jesus is coming soon. But not everyone calling Him "Lord" will go up (Matthew 7:21). The rapture is for wise virgins only. The foolish will be left behind (Matthew 25:10-12).
In 1 Corinthians, Apostle Paul declared,

"According to the grace of God which is given unto me, as a wise Master builder, I have laid the foundation, and another buildeth thereon. But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon. For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ" (1Corinthians 3:10-11).
The rapture is not for those building on another foundation – false prophets, false doctrines, or false practices. Here are 5 Signs of Another Foundation that will get you left behind:
1. Another Way to the father
Jesus said, "I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me" (John 14:6).
But this generation says there are other ways to the Father, and creates so-called co-redeemers. That is another gospel (Galatians 1:8). Another gospel will not get you raptured.
2. Another Baptism Formula
Jesus commanded baptism "in the name of the Father, and
of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost" (Matthew 28:19). The apostles obeyed by baptizing in the name of Jesus Christ (Acts 2:38). The name of the Father, Son, and Holy Ghost is Jesus (Colossians 2:9).

But this generation is doing the opposite, not baptizing at all or repeating titles instead of the name that Jesus commanded is disobedience — that is operating in error and it is another gospel. Don't be a foolish virgin who says, "It doesn't matter, just believe and trust God." Read through to the end of this book, and you will understand it all clearly.
3. Another Set of Ministries

Aside from deacons who serve the church, Apostle Paul gave us five offices known as the fivefold ministry for the perfecting of the saints: apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers (Ephesians 4:11-12).

But this generation invented extra titles for honour and glory. That is another gospel. The rapture is for the perfected church, not a man-made clergy system (Ephesians 5:26- 27). The church is washed by "the washing of water with the Word." False doctrine stains; truth applied from Scripture washes and keeps the church holy (Ephesians 5:27).
4. Another Doctrine: Spirit-Led vs. Believe Only
Jesus said,"Ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost" Acts 1:5

Paul explained, "If any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his" (Romans 8:9). No Holy Ghost, no heaven. No Holy Ghost, no rapture. Yet many stop at John 3:16 and say just believe and trust.
5. Another Sacrifice: Self-Righteous Works

After the cross, Jesus declared, "It is finished" (John 19:30). But this generation adds sacrifices and works for salvation, as if Christ's death was not enough. That is another gospel (Galatians 1:8). Come out of error and be rapture-ready. But the wise virgins watch everything. The foundation is finished (1 Corinthians 3:11). No man can add to it. The wise virgins build on the finished work with gold, silver, precious stones — the apostles' doctrine (Acts 2:42). The foolish build with wood, hay, and stubble — traditions, wrong doctrines, moralism, and new revelations that contradict the Bible. It will burn (1 Corinthians 3:13). They will be left behind.
Christ's blood finished the payment. The apostles' doctrine finished the pattern. You cannot add to the payment, and you cannot subtract from the pattern.

The wise virgins rest in Jesus' sacrifice and walk in obedience. The foolish trust works to save them, or trust grace to excuse disobedience. The difference is this: the wise virgin loves the truth, seeks it, and obeys it. The foolish virgin says it doesn't matter — just believe. Be wise.
The rapture is coming. Jesus is coming soon. The question is not "when." The question is whether you are ready.?
REFLECTIONS

Dear Reader, know this: apart from unbelievers who will make the wise decision to turn to Christ after reading this book, misled believers who will come out of erro, and wise vigins who are trimming their lamps as they read this book and amending their wrong doctrines for perfection, there are foolish virgins who may be waiting to hear, “I know you not” (Matthew 25:12).

Know this too—false prophets do not repent, they are the source of all heresy and rebellion. In this End-Time, people will persist in their choices, whether good or evil, as written in Revelation 22:11 (GNT).

Impostors may claim to have changed one or two of their doctrines, but in reality, it's not true. Paul says, “They will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived” (2 Timothy 3:13). “Beware of false prophets, Lord Jesus warned.” “You'll know them by their fruits' (Matthew 7:15-16).
They often:
v Refuse to acknowledge their errors
v Fail to repent of their deceit
v Continue to lead people astray
v Become more entrenched in their false teachings
v May even become more aggressive in defending their false claims
v Influence their followers to prefer idolization (blind devotion) of human leaders (the so-called 'GO', "Father in the Lord", etc.) over worshiping God alone and adhering to God's true word
v They hate the truth (2 Thessalonians 2:10)"
The reason false prophets often take the above positions is because they are often driven by:
Ø Pride and ego
Ø A hidden desire for honour and glory
Ø A craving for power and control
Ø A need for validation and followers
Ø A lack of accountability and humility
HOW GOD SEES THEM
§ They are the serpent's seed (Genesis 3:15).
§ Lord Jesus not only hates their hypocrisy, He calls them the TARES (Matthew 13:25).
§ They are not to be loved, nor pitied (Deuteronomy 13:1-8, Psalm 139:21-22)
In contrast, true prophets are the children of God who:
ü Recognize their mistakes and weaknesses
ü Humbly repent and correct their errors
ü Prioritize truth and accuracy
ü Seek accountability and guidance
ü Emphasize God's glory and purposes over personal gain ü They love God and also fear him (Ecclesiastes 12:13, John 14:21, Hebrew 12:28-29)
ü They are the seed of the woman (Genesis 3:15).
ü Jesus loves them and calls them the WHEAT (John 14:21, Matthew 13: 38)
ü They are to be loved and followed (1 Corinthians 11:1)
Let's be wise, able to distinguish between true and false prophets.
Prayer; O Lord help me to always strive to follow you and obey your word, the truth.
THE NARROW GATE

“All scripture is inspired by God” (2 Timothy 3:16). And it is written, “Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth” (2 Timothy 2:15). Jesus says, “From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and

the violent take it by force” (Matthew 11:12). “And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me” (Matthew 10:38). He futher said, “Strive to enter in at the narrow gate...” (Luke 13:24). For those who see embracing wholehearted obedience to God and contending for the faith—the truth (Jude 1:3)—as being as extreme should consider this: Lord Jesus left family, possessions, and comfort for God's will, facing shame, persecution, and death. He declared those who do his sayings as being wise. (Matthew 7:24-26).

The Apostles were persecuted, stoned, and killed. Peter also declared, “Lord, to whom shall we go? Thou hast the words of eternal life” (John 6:68). Paul righteously worked hard and was ready to die for Jesus (Acts 21:10-13). These aren't
extremes; they're examples.

Let's arise and serve God acceptably (Hebrew 12:28-29). We must learn from the warnings, commendations and corrections of the seven Churches of Revelation 2 and 3 if we love God indeed. Learn from the 7 churches, only SMYRNA AND
PHILADELPHIA were serving God acceptably.
Hello, friends,

The signs of the end-time, as recorded in the Bible (Matthew 24, Mark 13, Luke 21, 2 Peter 2:1-2, 1 John 2:18), are clearly being witnessed in the world today! False prophets and antichrists have emerged in many places. They have deceived, and are still deceiving, multitudes.

“Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times (which is now) some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils; speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron.” (1 Timothy 4:1-2)
“For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.” (Matthew 24:24)
The Lord Jesus warned: “Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.” (Matthew 7:15).
THE RAPTURE / END TIME

Today, many people are confused as these scriptures are being fulfilled. False prophets and teachers have risen with worldly messages and doctrines of Satan, deceiving many and at the same time also being deceived themselves. Messages of financial prosperity, bowing before statues, shrines, or graven images in the name of prayer, honor, or worship, and the adulterated 'grace gospel' are common examples. These are perversions of the truth, and many are following them (Colossians 2:8; James 4:4; 2 Corinthians 2:17; Exodus 20:4-5; Revelation 9:20; Jude 4).
Lord Jesus continuously warned us about these corrupt teachings. He said: “Take heed and beware of the leaven (the doctrines) of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees...” (Matthew 16:6-12).
Apostle Paul described such teachings as “another gospel,” which carries severe consequences (Galatians 1:6-9).

Let's not forget that true worshipers are those who serve God in spirit and in truth—not in the flesh or error. This is what Lord Jesus told the woman of Samaria (John 4:22-24). Paul also made it clear that it's only those who walk according to the Spirit of God that shall not be condemned (Romans 8:1; 8:4 KJV).
Brethren, it is time to reflect on the life you are living.
Prayerfully seek the truth and understanding of the times we are in, so that you will be delivered from the lies of the devil.

Apostle John declared: "For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ." (John 1:17) Jesus also affirmed: "...and to this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice (John 18:37).
The Lord Jesus prayed to the Father: “Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.” (John17:17). And to us, He said: “And

ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.” (John 8:32)
Both Apostles Peter and Paul emphasized how imperative it is to know and obey the truth:
“God our Saviour... will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.” (1 Timothy 2:4)

Paul further said, “But we are bound to give thanks always to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth” (2 Thessalonians 2:13)

Peter wrote: “Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently.” (1 Peter 1:22). So we must seek the truth and obey it through the Holy Spirit.
Again Paul warned Timothy about these end-time signs:

“This know also, that in the last days (which is now) perilous times shall come. For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy, without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good, traitors, heady, high-minded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God; having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.” (2 Timothy 3:1-5).
And Jesus said: “And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.” (Matthew 24:12). These are the realities we see all around us today.
THE RAPTURE / END TIME
Have you observed the alarming level of iniquity and
wickedness in our society today?

Mammonism, intense hatred, killings, betrayal, kidnappings, irreconcilable differences in many homes as well as greed and crime dominate the lives of many. Violence is rampant, sicknesses and diseases are on the rise. The fear of God has departed from the hearts of many. “Christians” conforming to the world systems instead of conforming to the image of Christ, both in appearance and conduct (1 John 2:15-16). People go to church to seek miracles, fame, entertainment etc instead of seeking Christ, the Saviour.
Friends, be Watchful!
The Rapture is at hand. Search the Scriptures.
Hold fast to the Truth.
Prepare to meet the Lord!

The Bible has made it very clear to us who God is - His nature, His greatness, and the things that are an abomination unto Him. Just as God commanded Adam and Eve concerning what they should eat and what they must not eat, even so has He commanded us concerning worship. God Almighty says in Exodus 20:3, 34:14, “For thou shalt worship no other god: for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.” Moses echoed the same perspective about God in Deuteronomy 4:24, “For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.” Joshua also warned the people that God is a jealous God, and that they must not serve other gods but the Lord alone—He tolerates no rival, neither human nor thing.

God Almighty repeated the warning in Deuteronomy 5:9 that He is a jealous God. He explained in verse 8 that the making of images in the likeness of things in heaven or on earth is forbidden, and bowing down to them is an abomination to Him. The Lord started this warning in Exodus 20:4-5, “Thou shall not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of anything that is in heaven

above, or that is in the earth beneath or that is in the water under the earth. Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me.'' Three Hebrew men—Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego—refused to bow to Nebuchadnezzar's golden image, demonstrating true faith in God. Their action showed that bowing down to images of men or things is idolatry (Daniel 3:8-30). When Satan demanded worship from the Lord Jesus, as it is common even today, Jesus rebuked him, saying, “...for it is written, thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve” (Matthew 4:8-10). Again, He clearly warned in Isaiah 48:8 saying, "I am the LORD: that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images. From these Scriptures, it is very clear that our worship must be to God alone. But today, many professing Christians worship graven images, statues, and even the "Man of God", in the name of honor. Yet, even the angel of God warned us in Revelation 19:10 and 22:8-9 not to worship even angels—but God alone. Some individuals pray to deceased persons, “saints,” who themselves are waiting for judgment, requesting their intercession. Such practice is nothing but spiritism and idolatry (Hebrews 9:27, Deuteronomy 18:10-11, Leviticus 19:31). Just know it that only the living can intercede for the living. Glory be to God! Jesus Christ, the Resurrected one and our High Priest, is alive and praying for us (Hebrew 7:25). Many professed believers adorn themselves, their homes, offices, their vehicles etc with the pictures of “Men of God,” “saints,” or images perceived to be that of Christ, hoping for miracles or protection. These are idolatry. The Lord said, “My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge” (Hosea 4:6).

I myself was once guilty of these things but Christ saved me. Apostle Paul said, “Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ” (1 Corinthians 11:1), but today many follow “Men of God” who began falsely or who have long departed from the truth—because they are not watching.

Friends, do not be carried away by miracles, signs, wonders, or worldly achievements. You need to also know that it is not about whose church is first, second, largest, or most popular. Rather, watch through the lens of Scripture. The Bible says, “Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God...” (1 John 4:1), for there is the spirit of truth and the spirit of error (1 John 4:6). Remember also that God Almighty will test you with false prophets to see whether you truly love Him—or that Man of God (Deuteronomy 13:1-5).

Some believers today even pray through the “God of my Pastor,” “the God of this Commission,” or “through Virgin Mary,” in this present grace era?—that is idolatry. There is no record in Scripture where the Apostles prayed to or through the God of Moses, Elijah, Joshua, Peter, or Paul. Neither did they pray through any commission or person—but always in the name of the LORD JESUS CHRIST. He said, “If ye shall ask anything in my NAME, I will do it” (John 14:14). That is the perfect way of prayer. “Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other NAME under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved” (Acts 4:12). And it is only in His NAME that “every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth” (Philippians 2:10-11). Lord Jesus warned us against going through other ways, saying, “I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me (John 14:6) Again He says “Verily verily I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber. But he that entereth in

by the door is the shephered of the sheep” (John 10:1).
Therefore, brethren, be watchful and stop idolatry.
COMMISSION MANDATE

Some “Men of God” will tell you that their commission or mandate is prosperity gospel and that's why they focus on that, while others claim it is faith and dominion, grace, motivational preaching, prophetic ministry, holiness, prayer and deliverance, healing ministry, and so on. Don't mind them—there is no such thing written in the Bible.

The command of God is clear: “But seek ye first the kingdom of God, (secondly) and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you” (Matthew 6:33). Those of us who have repented and believed the gospel have been given the ministry of reconciliation, “to wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself...” (2 Corinthians 5:18-19).

We are to preach the kingdom of God (Acts 28:31), to preach “Christ crucified” (1 Corinthians 1:23), and make them that believe Disciples of Christ (Mark 16:15-16). Every other thing is possible for us to do or become only in the NAME of the Lord Jesus (John 14:14; Matthew 21:22).

Therefore, brethren, be watchful, starting with you. Study your Bible diligently and pray to receive the Holy Ghost, that you may know the truth—and “the truth shall make you free” (John 8:32). And bear in mind, speaking in tongues is not always the evidence that a person has received the Holy Ghost. As you continue reading this epistle to the end, you will understand these things more perfectly.

MATERIALISM

Friends, are you watching the level of worldliness going on in Christendom today? Yet the Bible has forewarned us to “set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth” (Colossians 3:1-2).

Again, the Scripture says, “Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him. For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world. And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth forever” (1 John 2:15-17). And also, “For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace” (Romans 8:6).

But today, many “believers” have set their hearts on this present world and its beauty—which shall surely pass away. Apostle Paul did not boast in earthly things, but rejoiced in the glory that awaited him in God, and even gloried in his tribulations, saying, “We glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience” (Romans 5:3). But now, we see “Christians” boasting of earthly acquisitions—luxurious cars, mansions, private jets, cathedral churches, academic degrees and titles, fat bank accounts, influential friends and the like. These are the very things that worldly people glory in—and to glory in them is to be carnally minded. All these and more are why Lord Jesus warned us in Luke 12:15; “Watch out! Be on your guard against all kinds of greed; a man's life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions”.

He also asked; “For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?” (Mark 8:36). I say, Nothing, Lord! Friends, worldliness has deeply entered the “church” in these last days. That is why many focus their gospel on
IDOL WORSHIPS: WITHIN
materialism—things which they will surely leave behind, only to face judgment.

We are witnessing exactly what the Bible says: “For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; (such as this epistle) but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears; and they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables” (2 Timothy 4:3-4). That is why they despise the truth and embrace lies. When you correct them in love, they say, “You are judging me.” They call rebuke “condemnation,” they call holiness and righteousness “over-spirituality” and they call modest dressing “religious.”

But we, the seed of God, must “give diligence to make your calling and election sure” (2 Peter 1:10). “For we were once lost and in darkness, but now we are called into His marvelous light.” Therefore, we must shine as lights—in our
conversations, in our character, and even in our outward
appearance (1 Peter 2:9-10). For “if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new” (2 Corinthians 5:17).

Some groups of “Christians” even say there is no hell fire—because they hate the truth (2 Timothy 4:3-4). But be assured of this one thing: the high standard of God has not changed and will never change! So watch and be sober, Jesus is coming very soon.
He that hath ear, let him hear what the Spirit is saying to the Churches.

In Jude 4, we were warned that in the last days (which is now), grace abusers—whom the Bible says are marked for hell—would sneak into the church unnoticed. This is already happening. But we, the children of God, are alert. Some of them will preach grace at every opportunity—week after week, year after year. They are very crafty in what they do. They will often quote scriptures like Romans 4:4-5, Romans 10:9-11, Ephesians 2:8-9, Romans 3:24-29, and Romans 5:1, but they fail to give the full picture. They won't tell you that “the grace which brings salvation also teaches us (helps us) to deny ungodliness” (Titus 2:11-12). The bible says in Romans 3:23 “For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;' meaning man can't please God by his own ability. Jesus confirms in Mathew 19:26, “With men this is imposible; but with God all things are possible.” So, a believer must put faith in Christ to serve God “in spirit and in truth.” Paul says in Philipians 2:13, “For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.” So, the Lord is the one that helps those that believe and are poor in spirit to
GRACE IS ABUSED
practice James 1:22 which says, “Be you doers of the word and not hearers only, deceiving youself.” Again Paul clearly said: "...Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound? God forbid...”
(Romans 6:1-2).

The abuse of grace has made many “Christians” live like the people of the world. They have replaced obedience with faith alone. But friends, our faith must produce good works. Even Abraham, the father of faith, after God told him to offer his only son Isaac, He believed—and acted on that faith by going ahead to sacrifice him (Genesis 22:1-14). That's good works. Remember, “faith without works is dead” (James 2:17).

Furthermore, the Bible says: "Shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works." (James 2:18- 26). Similarly, those who are hiding under the cover of grace to practice unrighteousness, hear the truth: The law says that if you are caught committing adultery with a woman you are guilty (Exodus 20:17). But under grace, the Lord Jesus raised the standard higher and said: “Whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.” (Matthew 5:28).

He gave many examples in Matthew 5:27-45 of how the standard has been raised under grace. Why? Because grace is not only an unmerited favour but empowerment as well. That's why Apostle Paul said: “For the grace of God that bringeth salvation (the grace we must look for) hath appeared to all men; teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present world.” (Titus 2:11- 12,). “Note this: no one earns salvation by good works, but we are saved unto good works and we are to discern what is acceptable before God...” (Ephesians 2:10; 5:1-11). Our good works after

END-TIME: WATCH

believing in Christ aren't dirty before God—it's a command! Consider this example: God anointed Jesus Christ with the Holy Spirit and power, who went about doing good... (Acts 10:38). The Apostles were called Christians for their adherence to Jesus' teachings (Act 11:26). Apostle James says, “...So, faith without works is dead also" (James 2:26). Friends, grace empowers us to live a holy and righteous life. Apostle John says, 'If ye know that he is righteour, ye know that every one which doeth righteousness is born of him.' (1 John 2:29; 3:7).

But many stop at good works, which becomes self-righteousness if it is done outside of a pure heart in Christ (1 Corinthians 13:3). Things like giving to the poor, helping one another, regular church activities and services, evangelism, etc, become empty works if done while ignoring a personal, obedient relationship with God—seeking Him through revelation and true discipleship (Matthew 16:16-19; Romans 1:17).
Paul warned that the disobedient went about establishing their own righteousness, meaning they served God on their own
terms. This is self-righteousness, and it brings grave
consequences.
Paul further warned: “For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness.” (Romans 1:18).

They provoked God's wrath because they changed the truth they knew into lies, inventing false doctrines and idolatrous practices. This led to their being given over to a reprobate mind (Romans 1:18-32).

Some of these false prophets never started well; they knew exactly what they were doing from the beginning. Others started well but were later distracted by the cares, pleasures, and riches of this world, causing them to abandon the truth (Mark 4:18-19,
GRACE IS ABUSED
Galantians 5:7).
Lord Jesus pronounced them as belonging to the synagogue of Satan and as workers of iniquity (Revelation 2:9; 3:9; Matthew 7:22). But remember, “By their fruits ye shall know them.” (Matthew 7:20).
