And He went on to pronounce many blessings upon Abraham. Therefore, true obedience attracts blessings, and brings friendship with God.

The Lord likewise commended the Church in Smyrna, encouraging them to continue in the fight of faith unto the end. He said unto them: “I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty (but thou art rich)... Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer...” (Revelation 2:8-10). This church was poor physically, yet rich spiritually. Friends, the state of our spiritual life ought to be our concern. Let us, therefore, watch, and amend our ways.
THE SEVEN CHURCHES OF
THE APOCALYPSE

Also, to the Church in Sardis the Lord gave a warning, saying: “Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.” He further warned: “If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee” (Revelation 3:2-3). This church thought it was doing well, being physically prosperous, but they watched not over their spiritual state—their doctrines and their works before God.

And mark this: the Lord Jesus said He would come unto them. But this coming in this context is not the Rapture; it is in line with Revelation 2:2-5, where He warned the pastor of the Church in Ephesus that He would remove his candlestick (that is, the presence of God) out of its place unless he repented. Can you see now that many—even though they work miracles, signs, and wonders; even though they have shown love to many, planted churches, or very skillful in singing praises to God, helped the poor, fasted, prayed regularly, welcomed strangers, and even built orphanage homes (1 Corinthians 13:3)—yet are vessels unto dishonour? (2 Timothy 2:19-20). Why? It is because of their doctrines and practices. So you need to be watchful and ready for the rapture. Do not stop at repentance from sin, or build your faith on morality. Watch your doctrine and conduct.

The LORD says: “Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame” (Revelation 16:15). Jesus says, "And what I say to you I say unto all, Watch (Mark 13:37)

sections.title: Watch the Spirit, Yourself & the Man of God

blocks.text: In 1John 4:1 and verse 6, Apostle John writes, “Beloved, believe not every spirits, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world. He continue to explain how to identify these false prophets, and in verse 6, he says, “We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; (believe our message, the truth, even this epistle) Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of erro”. Therefore, let him that thinks he is standing firm watch! Watch also what the spirits speak to you, for even fallen angels do speak to “men of God.” Remember the soothsayer in Philippi, who spoke accurately, yet by a demonic spirit (Acts 16:16-18). Eve was not watchful, and Satan spoke to her, and she was deceived (Genesis 3:1-5). It was lying spirit also that spoke through the prophets who deceived King Ahab (1 Kings 22:19-22).

In this time, we have heard of a prominent “man of God” who preached holiness and rebuked sin, yet said he used to have meetings with Isaiah, Jeremiah, the twenty-four elders, and sometimes even Paul etc. This is spiritism and spiritual
WATCH THE SPIRIT, YOURSELF
& THE MAN OF GOD

fornication. Such person is being deceived by fallen angels who transform themselves as angels of light (2 Corinthians 11:14-15). He had fallen away because he was not watchful. And this falling away is still ongoing, as it is written (2 Thessalonians 2:3).

Brethren in the Holy Ghost School, watch! That you will not be among those who have fallen away, or who practice spiritism, whether knowingly or unknowingly. And forget not the gathering of the brethren (Hebrews 10:25), as some do. The Scripture says: “Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend” (Proverbs 27:17). Therefore, the fellowship of believers is required of us as the apostles gathered together on Sundays to worship the Lord (Acts 20: 7).

There are some “men of God” who will make you believe that your blessings and spiritual growth can only come through them—do not believe them. Though we must render honour to whom honour is due but not worship (Romans 13:7), and though we may identify with those who have laboured in teaching and mentoring us, provided they have not departed from the truth, but remember that Jesus said, “Ye are all brethren.” Paul called Timothy his son in the faith because he brought him up in the Gospel (1 Corinthians 4:15), yet we are to be mindful so that we do not idolize any man, even though he prayed or interceded for us. You must bear in mind that the Lord Jesus warned us not to call anyone Father or Master here on earth, for we have only one Father who is in heaven and Jesus, our Master and Rabbi. We are all brethren before Him. (Matthew 23:8-10). The apostles and even Timothy, whom Paul called his son, called no man “Father in the Lord,” as it is now commonly practiced.
Brethren, someone that is still alive can pray for you but bear in mind that in this dispensation of grace, the Lord Jesus alone is the source of our blessings. He alone is the Mediator between God
THE TRUMPET IS BLOWING
END-TIME: WATCH

and men, and our great High Priest who deserves our total submission (1 Timothy 2:5; Hebrews 4:14-15; 7:25). He says: “Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest” (Matthew 11:28). Some of these “men of God” desperately desire followership, and so they make themselves as semigod; and their followers, in calling them “Father in the Lord,” put too much faith and love in them. Hear this: if you are doing such things, both you and the one whom you idolize have fallen away, and become false prophets.

The Bible never said, “Believe the false prophet, so shalt thou prosper” (2 Chronicles 20:20); rather, “watch” (Matthew 7:15- 16). The Scripture also says in Deuteronomy 13:1-5 that if a prophet or a dreamer of dreams should rise to turn you away from the LORD your God by their doctrines or teachings, you should ignore such a person!

Friends, if you want to make heaven,—not merely earthly blessings—know this: we are at war with the devil. His weapons of warfare are deceit and accusation (Genesis 3:1-7; Revelation 12:10). Therefore, watch and pray.
SELF CHECK, A MUST

Self-examination is essential, especially in this last hour, not minding your position or title. Apostle Paul, writing to the Corinthian church, said, “Examine yourself to see if your faith is genuine. Test yourself. Surely you know that Jesus Christ is among you; (to know if truly you have the Holy Ghost) if not, you have failed the test of genuine faith.” (2 Corinthians 13:5). Paul knew by the Spirit that many would be carried away with miracles, signs, and wonders, or by the physical greatness of the church, and he gave this charge to all of us. Therefore, even if you pray or prayed for and received a miracle, you still need to watch!
WATCH THE SPIRIT, YOURSELF
& THE MAN OF GOD

Years ago, God healed me of a spinal injury for which I was referred to India for surgery which doctors predicted a 50/50 chance of survival, along with huge expenses involved. He also healed me of heart disease, and of many other afflictions. And by His mercies, many have been healed through me also—but still, I watch.

When miracles begin to flow through your ministerial works—watch! Even if you have raised the dead—watch! If you have the grace/anointing to destroy shrines, family evil altars, or covenants—still watch! For it may yet be that you have fallen, or are numbered among the false prophets. Study carefully Deuteronomy 13:1-5; it says that even if a prophecy comes to pass, you must still watch, because your doctrines matter before God.

The Lord Jesus, warning the Church of Sardis, said: “Strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God” (Revelation 3:2). Friends, even with good works, if you do not watch' your doctrines may yet take you to hell fire if you fail to repent.

When you make a decree or prophecy and it does not come to pass, you should not be angry with God, neither seek a solution from the devil but watch! Ask the Lord, “What am I not doing well? What do you want me to do now?" Even I, as a friend of God, asked Him such questions many years ago after my midnight prayers—not because I did not see answers to my prayers, but to be sure I was standing well before Him. And He opened mine eyes to see certain things in which I needed to repent—things I was not mindful of.
Brethren, what the Lord Jesus showed me that faithful night in a dream shook me. I am already writing a book on that revelation, in fact, that was what prompted this book. I realized that had the
THE TRUMPET IS BLOWING
END-TIME: WATCH

trumpet sounded before that day, I would have missed heaven—God forbid! Friends, no matter the situation, do not make a vow unto God and fail to redeem it. “Better is it that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay” (Ecclesiastes 5:5). The Almighty says He does not have pleasure in fools (Ecclesiastes 5:4).

I had issues with making pledges to God and forgetting or delaying to redeem them. I also struggled with uncontrolled anger. But the fruit of the Spirit must be manifest in the life of every born-again Christian (Galatians 5:22-23). These are the things I repented of that day. He delivered me—because I was watching.

In that same dream, I saw that if the trumpet were to sound today, over 99% of those who profess to be “born-again Christians” would miss it. As I said, I am writing a book on that already. In that book, you will see why many “men of God” fall away from the faith without knowing. Many were warned by the Lord concerning their pride, tribalism, partiality, lack of genuine love, their direct or indirect stealing of God's glory, their racism, their greed, their idolatry, their unforgiving spirit, their prosperity Gospel and many other things. Yet they were stubborn and refused to repent. That is why Apostle Paul warned: “he that thinks he is standing we'll take heed” (1 Corinthians 10:12). Had Adam been watchful, he would have discerned that his beloved wife, Eve, was speaking by the order of Satan, and he would have rebuked her. Paul by the Holy Spirit discerned that the soothsayer in Philippi, who told everybody the truth about whom they were, was operating by a demonic spirit because he was watchful (Acts 16:16-18). Therefore, watch everything so that you will not walk in error, and regret it on the last day.
WATCH THE SPIRIT, YOURSELF
& THE MAN OF GOD

Apostle Paul, writing to the Church in Galatia, said: “I marvel that you are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel: which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ. But though we (the Apostles) or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed” (Galatians 1:6-9). Again, he wrote to the Church in Corinth, saying: “According to the grace of God which is given unto me, as a wise masterbuilder, I have laid the foundation, and another buildeth thereon. But let every man take heed of how he buildeth thereupon. For another foundation can no man lay than that which is laid, which is Jesus Christ” (1 Corinthians 3:10-11). As I stated in the introduction the foundation is finished. No man can add to it. The wise virgin built on the finished work with gold, silver, precious stones—the apostles doctrines (Act 2:42). The foolish try to lay another foundation with wood, hay, stubble—traditions and new revelations that contradict the Bible. It will burn (1 Corientians 3:13)
ANOTHER FOUNDATION /
ANOTHER GOSPEL

Friends, Paul forewarned us of all these false doctrines and practices that are everywhere today. And truly, these things point clearly to the times we are in—the end-time. I can only outline some of them in this epistle that every seed of God may be alert, and come out of error. We must walk in the perfect will of God, just as the Apostles did (Romans 12:2).

Hear this truth: those who repeat or attempt to recreate the sacrifice of the Lord Jesus on the Cross are blaspheming against God Almighty. The work was finished, and the Lord Jesus Himself declared: “It is finished” (John 19:30). Both Apostle Paul and Apostle Peter affirmed in the Scriptures that the atonement for our sins—His sacrifice—was done once and for all. It should never be repeated. No other sacrifice—whether burning of incense, burnt offerings, animal sacrifices or restitution is required again for the forgiveness of sins or for salvation. Consider these Scriptures: (Hebrews 7:27; 9:12; 10:10, 10:14; Romans 6:10; 1 Peter 3:18). As I said earlier ‘the wise virgins rest in Jesus' Sacrifice, and walk in the obedience. The foolish ones trust in their works to save them, or trust in grace to excuse disobedience. Christ finished the payment. The apostles' doctrine finished the pattern. You cannot add to the payment, and you cannot subtract from the pattern.

Friends, many wrong doctrines and practices have been going on in synagogues, temples, and churches, even before, during, and after the earthly ministry of Christ. But it is now exceedingly alarming in this end-time. People treat the communion wafer (the “host”) as though it was the very physical appearance of the Lord Jesus Himself, worthy of worship and adoration—it is idolatry. Many church folks focus on the outward ceremonies and practice rituals of communion rather than the spiritual significance of the communion. They erroneously hold the view that these rituals—borrowed from paganism—are necessary for salvation
THE TRUMPET IS BLOWING
END-TIME: WATCH
and forgiveness of sins whereas salvation is by faith in the Lord Jesus alone. All such practices are erroneous, and they lead to hell.

Again, those who put their faith in aprons, healing soaps, perfumes, candles, scapulars, or who prays with chaplets or “graven images”—even of the Cross—are idolaters. Some even believe in carrying so-called staff of office (crosier) as Moses did, or crosses, sometimes with images of a human on it, thinking it to be holy. These are clear acts of idolatry (Exodus 20:4-5).

Know it again: the Lord Jesus declared, “... God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth” (John 4:23-24). Not with ceremonial observances or rituals. It should be abundantly clear that the Lord Jesus is no longer on the Cross. He is risen, glorified, and has given us, the true believers, hope and victory (1 Corinthians 15:14, 55-57).
Praise the Lord!
Hallelujah!

Likewise, those who charge money to minister in the house of God, or those perpetual beggars who after evangelizing in motor parks or public palaces will turn around and begin to beg for money. Paul says that their belly is their God (Philippians 3: 18- 19) or those so-called “men of God” who demand that people sow seeds to receive miracles—or who ask for payment before they can be seen—are obviously false prophets. The Bible says: “... freely ye have received, freely give” (Matthew 10:8).
As I said, some of them even demand reverence, requiring that people kneel before speaking with them. This is nothing but idolatry.
ANOTHER FOUNDATION /
ANOTHER GOSPEL

Furthermore, as servants of God in this era of grace, we are not commanded to wear white garments, robes, clergy collar, belts or sashes, priestly garments, or any religious regalia, as was required under the old covenant (1 Samuel 2:28). Besides the honour and worship of men that such garments often attract today (Matthew 23:5-10)—which this generation seeks—is not of God. The Apostles, who walked in the perfect will of God, sought no such things. And we know that there is no anointing attached to such garments.

“Again, those men wearing caps of any kind in church and women not covering their heads are serving disorderly. Paul declared: “But there is one thing I want you to know: The head of every man is Christ, the head of woman is man, and the head of Christ is God. Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head (Christ). But every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head—she is just like the woman who has her head shaved. For if a woman doesn't cover her head, she might as well have her hair cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or her head shaved, then she should cover her head. A man should not wear anything on his head when he worships, for man is made in God's image and reflects God's glory. And the woman reflects man's glory” (1 Corinthians 11:3-7 NLT) Friends, Don't allow your title deceive you!". As I said earlier, the clear difference between the foolish virgins and the wise virgins is this: the wise virgins love the truth, seeks it, and obey it, but the foolish virgins say it doesn't matter.
Beloved, hold fast to the truth and beware of another gospel and another foundation.
Amen.
THE TRUMPET IS BLOWING
END-TIME: WATCH
IS MY TITLE BIBLICAL?

Friends, know this again: God Almighty will not share His glory with anyone (Isaiah 42:8). The Apostles laid the foundation for us and gave us five offices to operate in. They are apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors and teachers (Ephesians 4:11). But this generation is doing the opposite, inventing their own doctrines and practices—which will ultimately lead to destruction. Lord Jesus warned us in Luke 14:11 “For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he who humbles himself shall be exalted.”

Hear this truth: the word/title “Reverend” is never attributed to man in the Bible. That Holy name belongs only to God Almighty—YAHWEH, the One who exists by Himself. In Psalm 111:9 it is clearly written, “He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant forever: holy and reverend is his name.” Did you hear that! Holy and REVEREND is HIS name—it signifies the holy and awe-inspiring nature of God Almighty. He is the Creator of heaven and earth, the Commander of the armies of heaven, the Worker of wonders, the Alpha and Omega, the Beginning and the End, the Consuming Fire. In His NAME every knee must bow, in heaven and on earth. He alone is to be REVEREND, worshiped, and feared among men.

So, for any man to bear “Reverend,” “Holiness” or any other name or title that belongs to God alone is blasphemy. Such persons must repent and cry to God for mercy and forgiveness now, while mercy is still available.

Also, the word “Bishop" in the Bible refers simply to an overseer or leader in the church department (1 Timothy 3:1-13), not what people have turned it into today—where a man is exalted to the point of being worshipped in the name of “honor.” The Apostles, who walked in the perfect will of God, never practiced such exaltation of men. Likewise, a deacon in Scripture is to serve the
ANOTHER FOUNDATION /
ANOTHER GOSPEL

church, and he must be a man of one wife—not single, and not female—but a man who fulfills God's order (1 Timothy 3:12). Hear this, any day you begin to see yourself as a special being; that is the day you die. Lord Jesus warned, “Remember therefore where you have fallen and repent” (Revelations 2:5). "Yes, in Psalm 82:6, we are called gods, and Lord Jesus Christ affirms this in John 10:34. However, this lordship enthronement is not for this present world. Revelation 19:16 reveals Jesus' title: “KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.” This celebration of Jesus reigning over us is in heaven, not here now. Verse 11 sets the scene: 'I saw heaven open, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True...' It is clear it will happen in heaven. Sadly, some have taken this lordship upon themselves, seeking worship and honour of men – that is blasphemy.

Again, those who directly or indirectly worship human beings—“good people,” or “saints”—in the name of celebration or honor should remember that whatever good we do is given to us by God, and only God is good. The truth is this: whatever good works we do are gifts of God's grace. David could not have written the book of Psalms and many other things if it had not been given to him by God. The same applies to Moses, Abraham, Elijah, Peter, John the beloved, and many others. Therefor, it is unnescessary, and sinfull to name buildings, “Saint this” or Saint that,” or to make some people appear as co-redeemers. All glory and adoration belongs to God Almighty alone. Some even elevate their deceased loved ones, acknowledge their deeds, declare them “saints,” and mark special days to celebrate them. These reverences and venerations are clear idolatry. Let it be clear: No one is a co-redeemer but Jesus. Not even the 12 Apostles.For it is written in Acts 4:12 NIV- "Salvation is found in no one else..." 1 Timothy 2:5 NIV- "For there is one God and one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus."`
THE TRUMPET IS BLOWING
END-TIME: WATCH

Friends, if you love God indeed and willing to obey Him, and you go ahead to seek Him with all your heart—you will find Him, and He will reveal the truth to you (Jeremiah 29:13; John 8:31-32). You will find Him just as the Apostles did. You will not be among those who are enemies of the Cross, whose belly is their god (Philippians 3:18-19), or among those seeking God for fame, titles, and worldly honor. Jesus said they love “greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues” (Luke 11:43). The Lord called them hypocrites and said, “In vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men” (Isaiah 29:13; Matthew 15:8-9).

Hear this again: There is no record in the Bible where God called a person to serve Him as an evangelist, then later changed him to pastor, then promoted him to senior pastor, then prophet, senior prophet, apostle, senior apostle, and so on. Such practices are not biblical and are wrong. As earlier stated, aside from deacons who serve the church, Apostle Paul gave us only five office in this grace era—what we call the fivefold ministry: apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers. For the perfecting of the saints for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Chrict: (Ephesians 4:11-12). Every other title men have created for “special honor” is man-made and erroneous—that is another gospel. We are not to seek the honor of men, but the honor of God. Yes, God Almighty will honour some people on the last day and it will not be because of their title. He is not a respecter of man (Romans 2:11, Acts 10:34) instead, it is for those who served well, who are humble indeed and have no room for pride or ego.

Friends, remember what the Lord said; “I am the LORD: that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images” (Isaiah 42:8). Today, as we can see many give glory to men, graven images, and some people enjoy being addressed with titles like “God's General.” Just know it:
ANOTHER FOUNDATION /
ANOTHER GOSPEL
Nobody is “God's General” as people proclaim. All who are truly born again—whether young or old—you are simply a servant of God.

Apostle Paul, writing to Timothy, said, “Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ” (2 Timothy 2:3). Paul described the young Epaphroditus as “my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier” (Philippians 2:25)—not “God's general”—because of his steadfastness, work, and sufferings for the faith. In greeting sister Apphia and others who labored in Philemon's house fellowship, Paul called Archippus a soldier (Philemon 1:2; Colossians 4:17). He acknowledged both the young and old who labored to keep the work of God going—but none were called God's generals.
Let us know our roles and our boundaries as children of God that we may not, directly or indirectly, share in God's glory.
“He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches”.

sections.title: Women’s Ministry: What Does the Bible Say?

blocks.text: Friends, now that we have the Bible, we have no excuse if we do not walk orderly by following the Scriptures' guidelines in serving God. We are founded on the apostles' doctrine, and Jesus Christ himself is the chief cornerstone” (Ephesians 2:20). We ought to follow the footsteps of the Apostles, as they followed Christ. Apostle Paul was very clear on how the Church of God should be run. There is no such office in Scripture as Pastor (Mrs.), Deaconess, Apostle (Mrs.), Mother in Israel, and the like. These are false doctrines, and they lead to hell fire.

Paul declared that “If a man desires the office of a bishop (to oversee the church or department) he desires a good work. A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife...” (1 Timothy 3:1-2). Did you hear that! Not a woman with one husband. Even our Lord Jesus did not ordain any female apostle, and the apostles, following the Lord's pattern, did not do otherwise. Why? Because in the church assembly, women are not
WOMEN'S MINISTRY:
WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY?

permitted to exercise authority over men,... (1 Timothy 2:11-14). Paul explained further, “For Adam was first formed, then Eve. And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression”

Now, in Galatians 3:28, Paul says: “There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.” This means we are all one in Christ, without discrimination. Friends, following God's guidelines is required of us. The Apostles followed Jesus' laid- down pattern, and that did not in any way bring discrimination to them, but rather promotion in God's sight.

In administration within the church, a pastor functions as a pastor, a prophet as a prophet, and likewise in all other offices. Even though we are one in Christ (salvation), yet by divine design, a man cannot carry a child in the womb; so also in church leadership, there is order. For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church (Ephesians 5:23, 1 Corinthians 11:3). This divine order does not make the woman inferior but complements the purpose of God for creation.

Being one in Christ means this: Whosoever believeth on Him (whether male, female, or children) shall not be ashamed (Romans 10:11). And again: “For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon Him” (Romans 10:12).

Understand it clearer this way: in church gatherings today, we count men, women, and children together as one congregation, and in sharing material things, all partake equally. But in the days of old, it was not so—they counted only the men. When our Lord Jesus fed the multitudes, they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children (Matthew 14:21;
THE TRUMPET IS BLOWING
END-TIME: WATCH

Consider also: when the people heard Jesus preach in His hometown, they said, “Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? And are not his sisters here with us?” (Mark 6:3). The names of His brothers were mentioned, but the sisters were not named, for such was the custom. But now that grace hath fully come, all are counted together. Grace brought inclusiveness and orderliness. The supernatural ability to walk in order is part of what grace brought—not only unmerited favour.

If it were the will of God for women to be ordained Apostles, the Lord Jesus would have done so, seeing the many godly women who followed and ministered unto Him—Mary Magdalene, Virgin Mary, Mary the sister of Lazarus, the woman with the alabaster box, Elizabeth, and others. Yet He did not ordain any of them as Apostles. That alone should speak volumes to us. Even the 12 Tribes of Israel were all led by Men (named after the sons of Jacob) Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Dan, Naphtali, Gad, Asher, Issachar, Zebulun, Joseph, Benjamin, (Genesis 49:28).

Friends, there are guidelines in serving God in the old and New Testament. It must be according to His instructions and pattern; else it is not acceptable unto Him. For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints” (1 Corinthians 14:33).

Grace did not bring disorder but brought holiness and righteousness in the fear of God. The Lord Jesus said, “For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven” (Matthew 5:20). Our faith must be genuine—flowing from a transformed heart—and we must live according to God's kingdom principles. The Lord also taught
WOMEN'S MINISTRY:
WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY?
us to pray, “Thy will be done on earth, as it is in heaven” (Matthew 6:10). And He said, “For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of Him that sent me” (John 6:38).

It is therefore our responsibility to do God's will here on earth. Paul wrote, “Work out your own salvation with fear and trembling” (Philippians 2:12). We are accountable to God for how we live and serve Him.

Remember Saul: he did not fully obey God's specific instructions and was rejected (1 Samuel 13:8-14). On the other hand, Noah and Moses followed God's detailed instructions in building the Ark (Genesis 6:13-22) and the tabernacle (Exodus 25:31; 39:42-- 43). Their obedience pleased God. The lesson is clear: God requires complete obedience from His servants. Our Lord Jesus testified, “And he that sent me is with me: the Father has not left me alone; for I always do the things that pleases him” (John 8:29). So let us follow Jesus' lay down pattern in serving him.

Friends, don't aspire after titles or seek promotion among men. Do not join a church simply because it is popular or new. Watch and do as commanded by God. If you are not called by God into one of the five-fold ministries (Ephesians 4:11), rejoice and be content, for you can serve God and make heaven without bearing any title. Those who were in the upper room on the Day of Pentecost received the Holy Spirit and will go to heaven—and many of them had no title nor special title (Acts 2:1-4, Romans 8:9, 8:14, 11:29). So you can see that it's not about title or fame. Don't be a among the foolish virgins.
Be watchful. Watch your heart. Watch your motives. Examine everything starting with you.
“He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches”.

sections.title: The Keys of the Kingdom of Heaven

blocks.text: The Lord said to Peter “And I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven.”

Friends, understand this—it is not physical keys that He was speaking about, and not just a key, but keys. Let us know what these keys are as stated in Matthew 16:13-19. But first, bear in mind that the knowledge of the truth, the revelation of eternal life, is secret and progressive. The Lord Jesus said to Apostle John, “Come up hither, (come up for further revelation) and I will shew thee (reveal) things which must be hereafter” (Revelation 4:1). Therefore, don't stop seeking growth in understanding and for further revelations.

The Lord Jesus asked His disciples, “Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?” And they answered, “Some say that thou art John the Baptist; some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.” They did not get it. Then He asked them directly, “But who says ye that I am?” Simon Peter answered and said, “Thou
THE KEYS OF THE
KINGDOM OF HEAVEN
art the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
Now, take careful note of Jesus' response to Peter, for herein is deep revelation:

“Blessed art thou, Simon Bar-jona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, (no human revealed this truth to you) but my Father which is in heaven” (Matthew 16:17). Meaning, no man gave you this knowledge—it was revealed by God Almighty Himself.

Then Jesus said, “And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter...” (The word Peter here is from the Greek Petros, meaning a small rock). But He continued, “and upon this rock I will build my church...” (The rock here refers to revelation—the revealed truth—not Peter the man). The Church of God is built upon revelation— “And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free” (John 8:32).

And this church is not a building or a denomination, but the people—those who have received the truth by revelation from the Holy Ghost. It includes Peter, the Apostles, me, you if it so be that you got it or anyone whom the Spirit of God hath revealed the truth of eternal life to. This very epistle you are reading is an example of a Holy Ghost-inspired revelation.

The Lord Jesus continued, “And the gates of hell shall not prevail against it”—it here refers to revelation not human. The accuser of the brethren cannot defeat revelation, because it is of God. The Holy Ghost will reveal these mysteries to the chosen (Mark 4:11).

He then said, “And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven...” (thee here refers to Peter, and by extension, to anyone who receives divine revelation by the Holy Ghost). The keys are revelations—not physical keys. Eternal life revelation
THE TRUMPET IS BLOWING
END-TIME: WATCH

knowledge is the keys to the kingdom of heaven. All the Apostles served God by revelation, "Paul, by Revelation, wrote the epistles and declared, “Whoever thinks he's spiritual must acknowledge these epistles, a commandment of God” (1 Corinthians 14:37). And remember: any true revelation today as I said earlier, must never contradict the Scriptures, for the Bible is our guide. The Lord continue and say,

“And whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven” (Matthew 16:19). The whatsoever in this context refers to revelation. It is not specifically about forgiveness of sins here, but revelation. Any revelation you bind here—by not releasing it—is bound also in heaven.

For example, the Lord said concerning Moses: “Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so” (Matthew 19:8). Moses sealed (or bound) certain truths because of their unbelief, and heaven acknowledged that. But now that the Lord Jesus has come with grace and truth (John 1:17), He revealed what had been hidden.

To Apostle John, He commanded: “Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand...” (Revelation 22:10). If John had sealed (bound) it, it would have been bound even in heaven. That's why He said to him, “Seal it not.”

Even I, to whom God hath revealed these truths, if I bind them by keeping them hidden and refuse to declare them to the public, they shall remain bound in heaven. And the consequences are like that of the parable of the talents. The servant who received one talent and hid it was cast into outer darkness (Matthew 25:29-30).
THE KEYS OF THE
KINGDOM OF HEAVEN
Consider Jonah: if he had refused to preach to Nineveh, the people would have been destroyed, and Jonah himself nearly perished for withholding the message (Jonah 1:1-2; 3:1-10).

Even you that read this message: if God hath revealed to you the truth to correct the false doctrines and practices present in many churches today—as you now receive from this epistle and more—do not keep it secret, so long as it aligns with Scripture. Let us “do the work of an evangelist” (2 Timothy 4:5), whether men will endure the truth or not. For we ought to obey God rather than men (Acts 5:29).

Friends, we can now see that our faith must grow to the level of revelation to be perfected. The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant (Psalm 25:14). Let us labour for that revelation and boldly declare it as commanded by God.
THE STAGES OF FAITH

Friends, our faith in Christ hath three stages; but many stop at stage one, some stop at stage two, while the overcomers attain to stage three, which is the victory and final stage. These stages are as follow:
1. Believe and Trust God:

This initial stage involves having confidence in God's existence, His goodness, and His promises. Some receive answers to their prayers easily at this level; many at this stage do miracles, signs, and wonders. They move mountains. It is the foundation of faith, where one begins to trust God.
THE TRUMPET IS BLOWING
END-TIME: WATCH
2. Believe, Trust, and Obey God:

At this stage, faith deepens as one commits to follow God's commands and principles. Obedience becomes a natural response to one's faith, which indeed is good, but many at this stage obey in error. As you read this book to the end, you will understand and come out of error.

3. Believe, Trust, and Know God by Revelation: This final stage, which only the winners attain, faith transcends mere obedience and entrance into the realm of intimate knowledge and understanding of the will of God. Here, one receives revelations of eternal life, divine insights, and spiritual discernment, total submission to God becomes one's joy.

Abraham practiced these three stages of faith. He believed and trusted that the promises of God would surely manifest; he believed that he would have a son despite his advanced age, and also that he would become the father of a great Nation. This foundational faith was accounted unto Abraham for righteousness (Genesis 15:6; James 2:23).

Now, the first stage led to the second stage—Believe, Trust, and Obey. Abraham's second stage of faith moved him to obey God and to depart from his home in Ur, journeying to a land unknown, which God promised to show him (Genesis 12:1-4). He believed God even to the point of offering up Isaac as commanded.

The first and second stages of Abraham's faith led to the third and final stage—the victory stage. This was when God began to reveal secrets unto him. The revelation stage of faith was seen when God revealed unto Abraham the impending destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah (Genesis 18:17-33). Even so, in these end times, only the elect shall know of the imminent return of the Lord Jesus and
THE KEYS OF THE
KINGDOM OF HEAVEN

of the destruction soon to come upon this wicked world. These chosen ones not only know and preach these truths but also fear God indeed, just as the Apostles did—and as Job, of whom the Almighty God was proud (Job 1:8).

Apostle Paul in like manner says, “The just shall live by faith” (Hebrews 10:38). The faith here is by revelation, not mere belief. Paul, by revelation, declared, “For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who by their unrighteousness suppress the truth” (Romans 1:17- 18). Without revelation, you cannot please God. This is what he meant when he said, “from faith to faith”—from revelation to revelation (Romans 1:17).

Paul further declared in Hebrews 11:3-4, “Through faith (by revelation) we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God. By faith (by revelation) Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice to God than Cain...” He proceeded to let us know how Noah built the Ark by revelation, and how others in that same chapter of Hebrews served God acceptably by revelation faith. Paul after hearing of the Ephesians church's strong faith and love toward believers, continually prayed that God should give them the spirit of Wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of Christ (Ephesians 1:15-17), that is knowing God by revelation.

Lord Jesus stated that the secrets of the kingdom of God have been revealed only to the elect (Mark 4:11). The elect—also called the chosen—are they who shall understand this epistle. Why? Because they love the truth, they seek it, and they practice it. They are the wise virgins. O Lord thank you for all these revelations.
THE TRUMPET IS BLOWING
END-TIME: WATCH
THE 9-GIFTS OF THE HOLY SPIRIT

Friends, in this grace era, for a church to function effectively, and not live in ignorance and in error, it is fundamental that, alongside the 5-fold ministry, the 9-gifts of the holy spirit must be in operational within it, Apostle Paul listed them in 1 Corinthians 12:8-10 as follows:
• Word of Wisdom (Sophia in Greek): The grace to
receive and apply divine wisdom in all
situations—providing insight and guidance for making right decisions and resolving difficult matters.

• Word of Knowledge (Gnosis): The supernatural ability to receive and share divine knowledge and insight. It helps believers to understand and apply biblical truths and provides discernment in spiritual matters.
• Faith (Pistis): This is the grace to believe and trust God in difficult circumstances and to take bold steps in
obedience to God's will. This corresponds to the first
stage of faith, as earlier explained.
• Gifts of Healing (Iamata): The grace to receive divine healing virtue—to restore physical, emotional, and
spiritual health to individuals through the power of God.
• Working of Miracles (Dunamis): The supernatural
ability to perform mighty works and wonders,
demonstrating the awesome power of God, and bringing glory to His Name.
• Prophecy (Propheteia): The divine ability to receive and declare messages from God, to edify, exhort, and comfort the church.
THE KEYS OF THE
KINGDOM OF HEAVEN
• Discerning of Spirits (Diakrisis Pneumaton): The
supernatural ability to distinguish between spirits,
whether they be of God or of devils, providing safety and purity in spiritual operations.
• Divers Kinds of Tongues (Glossolalia): The grace to
speak languages that are unknown for communicating with God in the Spirit, and for personal edification (1
Corinthians 14:4).

• Interpretation of Tongues (Hermeneia Glosson): The divine ability to interpret messages spoken in tongues so that the entire church may be edified and understand the message given by the Spirit. So, if your church is of God, the people with these gifts are within it. Let's discover them and allow them to use their God-given gifts!, let's strive to serve God acceptably (Hebrew 12:28-29).

sections.title: The Goodness of God and His Judgement

blocks.text: Our God is good all the time. Yes, the Lord Jesus Himself said, “There is none good but one, that is, God” (Mark 10:18). He is righteous, Holy, gracious, kind—and also a consuming fire. He is the only merciful, loving, and God of Justice. (Psalm 96:13; Deuteronomy 32:4). Yet many people—even “believers”—have misunderstood this uniqueness of God. That is why they say: “God loves you the way you are.” They believe that whatsoever a man does—even after believing in Christ—God is good enough to receive and accommodate it. But hear the truth.

Just know it again, that our Lord is good and also a God of justice. He was good when He destroyed the generation of Noah with a flood after their wickedness and evil works (Genesis 6:14-22; 7:23). He was good when He destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah with fire after their sin and abominations (Geneses 19:1-24). Yes, He judged them based on their conscience alone, unlike this generation that has the Bible, the blood of Jesus, the Holy Ghost,
THE GOODNESS OF GOD
AND HIS JUDGEMENT
and preachers of the true Gospel yet refuse to repent of their sins and reject the true Gospel of Christ.

The Lord Jesus reminded us in Luke 17:27-30 how the people were busy marrying, and giving in marriage (as is also happening now), until Noah entered into the ark, and the flood came and destroyed them all. He continued and said, “Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded” (even as is happening now), “but the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.” And the Lord said, “Even so shall it be on the day when the Son of man is revealed.” He also said in Mathew 7:22-24 “Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? And in thy name have cast out devils? And in thy name done many wonderful works? And then will I prophess unto them, I never knew you, depert from me ye that work iniquity, Therefor whosoever heareth these saying of mine, and doeth them, (obey them) I will linken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock.” In verse 26 He says: “And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, (refuse to obey) shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand: So, let us not take the goodness of God for granted.

Do not forget what transpired in heaven when Satan rebelled against the Almighty God, and he was cast out of heaven. The Lord God said, “Evil will not dwell in my sight.” (Psalm 5:4-5, Revelation 12:7-9, and Isaiah 14:12–15, Mark 9:43:48) God is holy and will not accommodate evil practices in his kingdom.

God was good when He destroyed twenty-three thousand Israelites in one day because they committed fornication and sinned against Him—even after He had delivered them from Pharaoh's bondage. Apostle Paul declared that these things
THE TRUMPET IS BLOWING
END-TIME: WATCH
happened as examples for us, the “believers,” who will turn back to their vomit to live in unrighteousness. (1 Corinthians 10:3-12).
Just know it again, beloved, that God Almighty will not accommodate sinners in His kingdom.

Now, who is a sinner? As I have said before in this epistle, a sinner is that person who rejects Christ or those who believe but continue to live in sin and disobedience (Matthew 7:21-26). Apostle John says that those who are born of God (born again indeed) do not commit sin (practice sin) and that whoever continues to live in sin is a child of the devil (1 John 3:8-9).

The destruction that took place of old shows us how God Almighty operates. He says, “I am the LORD, I change not” (Malachi. 3:6). He did not tolerate evil then in the Old Testament, and He will not tolerate it now. And herein is my joy—that evil shall not be accommodated in the kingdom of our God. Peter reminded us how God didn't spare the angels who sinned, nor the people of Noah's generation, nor Sodom and Gomorah's inhabitants, He saved only Lot. He says all these are examples for us, lest we turn back to our vomit and follow false prophets, whose end is destruction (2 Peter 2:2-7).

The Lord Jesus says, “But rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell” (Matthew 10:28). Hear this! If God Almighty were to overlook wickedness and not pour His wrath upon the ungodly—including false believers—then even heaven itself would no longer be a good place to dwell; for the perverse- minded would pollute it. But God forbid. Evil shall not enter into His holy habitation.
But for those who are truly born again, the Apostles are our examples. They followed the Lord Jesus' pattern, which is doing the will of God at all times. So also shall we, by the help of the
THE GOODNESS OF GOD
AND HIS JUDGEMENT
Holy Spirit do his will.

As we await the return of our Lord, more and more evil shall abound, but we, the children of God, remain watchful and steadfast. We are build on the foundation of the apostles and prophets (Ephesians 2:20, Act 2:42). He that hath ear, let him hear what the Spirit is saying to the Churches.

There are many reasons why people celebrate Christmas, but the obvious one is that the Saviour of the world was born, whose name is Jesus Christ, and they deem it necessary to mark His birthday, which is called Christmas. Many use the period to show love in various ways—exchanging gifts, having fun, visiting loved ones, and so on. And indeed, when one looks at the outward display of love shown by people during Christmas, it seems good and reasonable. But the truth is that every genuine born again Christian must serve God acceptably (Hebrews 12:28-29; Romans 12:1). We must walk in the perfect will of God, not just the permissive will (Romans 12:2; Ephesians 5:15-17).

It is clear that the Apostles followed the teachings and pattern of our Master Jesus Christ indeed, and so must we. Lord Jesus said to those that believed in Him, “If ye continue in my word, (my teaching) then are ye my disciples indeed” (John 8:31). It is therefore clear that Jesus came to raise disciples, not just mere believers (John 8:29-31). Doing otherwise will make our service
CHRISTMAS/ BIRTHDAY
CELEBRATIONS
to God vain and may become a stumbling block to us.

Now, the question is: Did Jesus celebrate His birthday? The answer is NO! There is no record of such in the Bible. Again, did the Apostles, who walked in the perfect will of God, celebrate His birthday—or even their own? The answer again is NO! Another question is: Were we commanded to celebrate His birthday? The answer is NO!

Furthermore, 25th December was not the date of CHRIST's birth, for the Bible gave no such record. Therefore, that date is false, and true Christians do not forge dates for sacred events. Now, what then was being celebrated on 25th December? History reveals that it was the Roman festival of Sol Invictus, meaning “Unconquered sun God,” celebrated on that day to commemorate the rebirth of the sun god. Another idol worshipped on that same date is Mithras, a god of “light” and fertility. Some Roman cults celebrated this idol on that day, while others worshipped Baal, a fertility god.

Now, another question: If I do not celebrate Christmas, have I sinned? NO! Again, if I celebrate Christmas, have I sinned? YES. Why? Because I am not serving God according to the laid down foundation of the Apostles and the pattern of Jesus' life as a true disciple.

Have you also considered the atrocities committed during the Christmas period? Even modern birthday celebrations have been characterized by human praises and worship in the name of honor—which is idolatry. As I often say to my family and brethren, “Every day is my birthday and a new day to thank God for His mercies.” David said, “I will bless the LORD at all times: His praise shall continually be in my mouth” (Psalm 34:1).
THE TRUMPET IS BLOWING
END-TIME: WATCH

Now, do we have any record of those who celebrated their birthdays in the Bible? Yes. The first was Pharaoh; what happened on that day? He restored his chief butler and hanged his chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted (Genesis 40:20-22). The second was Herod Antipas; on his birthday, he beheaded John the Baptist (Matthew 14:6–12; Mark 6:21-28). The other record of birthdays was concerning Job's sons, who feasted on their days (Job 1:4), but Job himself did not mark his own birthday.

It is clear, then, that the role models of birthday celebrations in the Bible are workers of iniquity, coupled with the wickedness that oftentimes takes place during such celebrations. The modern-day evils associated with birthday celebrations are often hidden, and only those who have the spirit of discernment that can see the human worship and praises of men that go on during such times. I myself was once guilty of such, but Christ saved me and opened the eyes of my understanding.

So, what then are we commanded to do in remembrance of our Lord Jesus? After blessing the bread and wine (which is the Passover, often called the “Last Supper,” and also known as Holy Communion), He gave it to His disciples and said, “Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me” (1 Corinthians 11:24-25; Luke 22:19-20). Therefore, it is this “Last Supper” celebration—the Holy Communion—that we are commanded to do in remembrance of Christ's sacrifice and victory—not Christmas or the Stations of the Cross, as men have devised.

Friends, there is nothing wrong in thanking God for a new day or for adding another year to your life, but it is better done privately between you and your God, to avoid all the human worship, pride, and unnecessary attractions that often accompany such occasions. This is why our Lord Jesus Christ did not encourage it,
CHRISTMAS/ BIRTHDAY
CELEBRATIONS
nor did the Apostles, because God will not share His glory with any man (Isaiah 42:8). O Lord, we thank you for all these revelations, which only the elect shall understand.

Friends, there are practices under the Law that are still to be observed even in this era of grace, such as sowing and reaping. “While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease” (Genesis 8:22). The Lord Jesus Himself said, “Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again” (Luke 6:38). And so also, if you sow evil, you will reap evil, even in this era of grace. Apostle Peter says, “But let none of you suffer as a murderer, (that's reaping the evil you sowed) or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters” (1 Peter 4:15). So, these laws of life were observed both in the Old Testament and in the New Testament.

But “Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot” (Exodus 21:24)—that is, paying evil for evil—was practiced under the Old Testament. The Lord Jesus came and nullified that. He said, “Whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to
SATURDAY / SUNDAY WORSHIP

him the other also” (Matthew 5:39). He went further and said, “Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you” (Matthew 5:44). Apostle Paul, in agreement, says, “Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not” (Romans 12:14). So, grace brought forgiveness and true love.

Now, concerning the matter of Saturday worship (the Sabbath day), which was observed as a day of rest and worship, The Lord Jesus fulfilled that law. He healed a man with a withered hand on the Sabbath (Matthew 12:9–14; Mark 3:1–5). He also healed the woman with the bent back on the Sabbath (Luke 13:10–17). Again, He healed the man born blind on the Sabbath day (John 9:1–41). So, the Lord Jesus was working on Saturdays. He said, “For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day” (Matthew 12:8). He rebuked the Sabbath day observers for their hypocrisy, asking, “What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it falls into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out? How much then is a man better than a sheep?” (Matthew 12:11-12).
So then, He nullified the Sabbath day keeping with its hypocritical observance.

Why then do we worship on Sunday? After the death of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ on the Cross, He resurrected on Sunday, the first day of the week. His resurrection brought us hope and victory (Matthew 28:1-10; John 20:1-10). That is why the early Christians gathered together on Sundays, not on the Sabbath day, to worship God (Acts 20:7; 1 Corinthians 16:2). This Sunday
THE TRUMPET IS BLOWING
END-TIME: WATCH
worship, also known as the Lord's Day, continues to this day. We, the Christians who are saved by grace, celebrate our Lord on His resurrection day, which is Sunday, and that is right and acceptable.
ATONEMENT FOR SIN:
ANIMAL SCERIFICE VS THE BLOOD OF JESUS

As highlighted earlier in the article, “another foundation, another gospel.” For forgiveness of sin to happen in the Old Testament, animal sacrifices was necessary for the atonement of sin. The blood of an animal had to be shaded by a priest but those sacrifices could only cover sin (Leviticus 1:3-7). However, the sacrifice of our Lord Jesus Christ on the Cross nullified the Old Covenant practice and established a New Covenant (Hebrews 10:1-8). John the Baptist declared, “Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world” (John 1:29). Apostle Paul explained that we are justified by Jesus' sacrifice on the Cross (Romans 3:24-25). The death of Jesus satisfied the requirements of the Old Covenant, which was not perfect, rendering animal sacrifices invalid, unnecessary, and simultaneously sinful (Hebrews 8:13; 10:18). Lord Jesus Himself declared, “It is finished”—meaning “Paid in full” (John 19:30). Any form of worship that requires the shading of animal blood undermines the precious work at Calvary. It is unnecessary and sinful.

Therefore, all that is required of us in this New Covenant is faith in the finished work on the Cross and obedience to God's truth—that is, following the teachings and examples of Jesus Christ and surrendering to the guidance of the Holy Ghost. But today, many believe, yet they walk in error, which is deception and spiritual darkness. It leads to separation from God and His truth. Those of us who are true believers should stand firm on God's word, resist deception and false teachings, and obey the truth even when it is
SATURDAY / SUNDAY WORSHIP
challenging or unpopular. We remain vigilant, knowing that the road to heaven is narrow as our Lord Jesus Himself said in Matthew 7:13-14.

Be a disciple of Christ (Mark 16:15–16) My brothers and sisters, let us give God our love and our whole hearts, for He first loved us (John 3:16; 1 John 4:19). It is only in Him that true love, righteousness, peace, and joy are found, and above all, eternal life (Romans 14:17).

If you are still living in sin, know that God sent His Son, Jesus Christ, who paid the price for your sins and mine. Why not repent with godly sorrow today, for tomorrow may be too late? Invite Him into your life with all your heart. Allow Him to be your Lord and Saviour and you shall begin to enjoy the newness of life in Christ Jesus with grace to live holy and righteous. For as many as received Him, to them gave He power to become the sons of God... (John 1:12).
If you desire to surrender your life to Christ, I invite you to pray this prayer sincerely:
Lord Jesus, I acknowledge that I am a sinner. I am sorry for my
ALTER CALL / BORNE AGAIN
cross and rose from the dead to set me free. Lord, give me grace to love You and to love my neighbor, as I love Myself and to be Your disciple all the days of my life. I pray in Jesus' name. Amen.

sections.title: The Godhead vs Trinity & Proper Water Baptism

blocks.text: Now that you have confessed Jesus as your Lord and Saviour, that is beautiful. But know that there are steps and processes to follow to become His disciple indeed. If you have said that prayer from your heart, please go for correct WATER and HOLY GHOST BAPTISM, that you may be endued with power for the race and for the continuation process of your new birth.

Why is that essential? Now that you believe, Lord Jesus said, “He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned” (Mark 16:16). Again, the Lord Jesus told Nicodemus, “Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God” (John 3:3). He went further to emphasize the significance of water and Holy Ghost baptism, saying, “Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God” (John 3:5).
And all true baptism must be done in the NAME of Lord Jesus Christ, as the Apostles did baptize in His NAME. “Then Peter
THE GODHEAD VS TRINITY &
PROPER WATER BAPTISM

said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost” (Acts 2:38). Again, when Peter preached to the household of Cornelius, as they believed, he emphasized on the indispensability of baptism and said, “Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?” And he commanded them to be baptized in the NAME of the Lord (Acts 10:47-48). “And now why tarriest thou? Arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the NAME of the Lord” (Acts 22:16).

Here are more scriptures that reveal the significance of baptism, the pattern, and confirm that the Apostles, including Paul, baptized believers in the NAME of the Lord Jesus (Acts 8:16; Acts 19:1-6; Romans 6:3–6; Galatians 3:26-27; 1 Corinthians 12:13). Now, in Matthew 28:19, after the finished work of the cross, the Lord Jesus, rising from the dead, commanded His disciples, “Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the NAME of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost”. Brethren, those three mentioned are one, for it is written, “The Lord our God is one Lord” (Deuteronomy 6:4; Mark 12:29)—not three in one.

Now, what is the NAME? It is JESUS CHRIST! He is the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost. He asked us to baptize in the NAME—not to repeat what He said, but to obey what He meant. Lord Jesus while explaining further that He is the three, said: “I am come in my Father's name, (what is the NAME? Jesus) and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own NAME, him ye will receive (John 5:43). Again he said in John 14-26, “But the Comforter, which is the HOLY-GOST, whom the Father will send in my NAME (what is the NAME? Jesus) he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you. For clarity on Jesus being the Father, the Son,
THE TRUMPET IS BLOWING
END-TIME: WATCH

and the Holy Ghost, see the prophecy in Isaiah 9:6: “For unto us a child is born, unto us son is given: and the government shall be his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.” See also John 14:7-11. God almighty Continuously made it clear in entire Isaiah 45, that he is God and beside him there is no other God, in verse 5 he says, "I am the Lord, and there is none else, there is no God besides me: l guided thee though thou hast not known me: Paul, writing to the Corinthian church, says, “...God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself...” (2 Corinthians 5:19). See also John 1:1. Again, Paul said to the Galatians, “And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father” (Galatians 4:6). "Jesus said, 'The first commandment is: Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord' (Mark 12:29)—One God. Even the Scribe agreed, 'The Lord is one God' (Mark 12:32-33) not 3 in one. “For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily (Colossians 2:9). Friends, you can see that the so called TRINITY is another gospel, God is not three. sections.title: The Lord Said, I Will Have Mercy..... But on Who?

blocks.text: The Almighty God, while conversing with Moses, said, “...And I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy” (Exodus 33:19). Apostle Paul also wrote, “It is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy” (Romans 9:16). Friends, many do not understand these scriptures, but the clarification is this: God Almighty shows mercy to those who love Him (Exodus 20:6). Who are they? Psalm 103:11 says, 'For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.' Verse 13 adds, 'Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.' Verses 17-18 explain that those who fear Him are those who obey His commands and do what pleases Him. As Psalm 128:1 says, 'Blessed are those who fear the Lord, who walk in his ways'. And Proverbs 9:10 says, 'The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom'... Many are called, but few are chosen (Matthew 22:14), yes, God Almighty hath chosen those few who truly love Him—they are those who believe,
THE LORD SAID, I WILL HAVE MERCY.....
BUT ON WHO?

follow, and obey Him continually (John 3:16, 3:21; Luke 9:23; John 14:15–17; Ephesians 1:4–9). They are marked for hell (Jude 4), same fate awaits those who continue in sin and disobedience after believing in Christ—they are the foolish virgins (1 John 3:8; 1 Corinthians 6:9–10). But He giveth more grace to the humble (James 4:6).

Apostle Peter said, “Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons: But in every nation he that feareth Him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with Him” (Acts 10:34–35). We, the children of God, know that God Almighty is not partial. It is by foreknowledge that God declared His displeasure against Esau even before he was born, for He knew Esau would be rebellious (Malachi 1:2–3). Likewise Pharaoh—God knew that Pharaoh would not repent genuinely, and that's why He even hardened his heart to demonstrate His power on him who hated God. (Romans 9:17–18). This situation is similar with false prophets and Antichrists—they shall not obtain mercy, because no matter how you preach the truth to them, they will not repent nor change their doctrines. Rather, they will defend their lies and even criticize the truth. The Lord said, “And I gave her space to repent of her fornication (false doctrines); and she repented not” (Revelation 2:21).

Just know that God Almighty will not force anyone to love or obey Him. He will even send strong delusions and stumbling blocks to the haters of truth (2 Thessalonians 2:9–10). Paul's arrest and conversion on the road to Damascus was not by force nor by compulsion, but by foreknowledge. God knew he was His vessel, and did it that way to confound the wise (Acts 9:1–31). Such may not happen to every vessel of God; that is why we

evangelize.

Even as I worked in ignorance; I was a committed churchgoer, always available in church activities, often going very early in the morning daily, even under the rain, rejoicing. But what led to my salvation—being genuinely born again—was troubles. Later, I backslid, that was around 1990's, but greater troubles brought me back to God after some years. Yet, during those days I had backslidden, I always cried to God for help, telling Him I did not like that condition. Even as a backslider, I missed Him. Every seed of God will always cry to God for help, not to man or the devil, the moment he or she discovers that you are on the wrong track.

Saul's appeal to Prophet Samuel, asking him to pray to his God for mercy, was hypocritical. God, who searches the heart of all men, knew that Saul's repentance was not genuine. His motive was driven by a desire to retain kingship and avoid public shame (1 Samuel 15:24-25). Know this: someone may ask God for mercy, and may not obtain it because of the condition of his heart, or because he himself has not forgiven others who sinned against him.
King Amaziah did that which was right before the Lord, but not with a perfect heart (2 Chronicles 25:2). Saul's appeal was not from a perfect heart.

It was different in the case of David. Whenever he realized his error or was made to know where he went wrong, he always genuinely returned to God asking for mercy. But later, he blamed himself, not God or others and declared “For we sought him not after the due order; (2 Cronicles 15:13). That's why the next time, he consulted God first before making a move to relocate the Ark of covenant.
THE LORD SAID, I WILL HAVE MERCY.....

That is divine wisdom.

• Humility – Recognizing the need for God's guidance and correction.

• Good Leadership – Taking responsibility for past
mistakes and doing God's will.

David came home one day and found his city burnt down and his people, including his wives and children, taken into captivity by the Amalekites. blocks.text: Friends, are you aware that false prophets have re-written the Bible, and many are still rewriting theirs? So, you had better be watchful, run for your soul, and stop following man, but
THE DEMAND OF THE HOUR:
WATCH EVERYTHING
God.

And if you have already started, watch still, for we must focus on His coming, engaging in true evangelism as commanded in Mark 16:15–16. Just as John the Baptist and the prophet Isaiah prepared people for the first coming of our Lord (Isaiah 40:3; Matthew 3:1–3), we also must prepare people for the second coming of the Lord Jesus, which is at hand. He says: “Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature. He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved...” (Mark 16:15–16). Remember, He says,“Behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be” (Revelation 22:12). And I say, “Come, O Lord,” and let the children of God say, “Come, O Lord.” Amen!

Friends, Lord Jesus gave us a new pattern of prayer He said, “Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy. But I say unto you, love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you” (Matthew 5:43-44). Apostle Paul also said, “Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not” (Romans 12:14). “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness in high places (Ephesians 6:12). See what I do in spiritual warfare? I declare, “Any arrow the enemy fired in my life, back to Satan in Jesus name, amen.” (Friends, our enemy is Satan) That defensive approach (“Back to sender or let my enemy die by fire or by thunder etc.”) is not Christ's way or the Apostles' prayer Style—we should follow their example as disciples of Christ. Yes, under the Law “Thou shall not suffer a witch to live (Exodus 22:18) but Christ has nullified that. Again in Isaiah 54:17, the Lord says, “Every tongue that shalt rise against you in judgement, thou shall condemn.” Cancel the negative spoken

words by the Word of God—not the person. See, if you study Isaiah 41:10, Duetronomey 3:22, Genesis 12:3, Isaiah 43:3-4 and 49:26, Psalm 89:23, 2 Cronicles 20:15 you will know that your enemies are dead already unless they repent. “Vengence is mine; I will repay, says the Lord (Romans 12:19). The Lord in many cases prepares a table before me in the presence of my enemies (Psalm 23:5). See, even when the enemy comes in like a flood, the Spirit of God will lift up a standard against him (Isaiah 59:19) So, ours is to ask for mercy on their behalf. That's a Christian—perfected in Christ (Mathew 5:44-48). Hear this also: Our Lord gave both example and command toward our enemies: — “Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do.” (Luke 23:34)

Yet those who withstand the true gospel receive swift judgment from God. This is according to the Word: — “The Lord your God proveth you... and that prophet... shall be put to death” (Deuteronomy 13:3-5)
There are two kinds of people who oppose the gospel:

2. The enemies of truth who withstand the Word of God— “Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil... the Lord reward him according to his works” (2 Timothy 4:14)
For such, we hand them to the righteous Judge (Psalm 37:9; Romans 12:19)

Elymas the sorcerer withstood Paul, and Paul said, “O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?” —And immediately the hand of the Lord was upon him,

and he was blind ( Acts 13:8-11)

(Acts 8:20). So, in this grace era, is clear that, the prayer of let my enemy die is another gospel, but to declare the Lord reward him that opposes the true gospel is in order.

You love your enemies because, as a product of mercy and grace, the Lord Jesus who saved you is your Master and Role Model. “For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them” (Luke 9:54-56). All the men of this world shall hate you (Matthew 10:22), but you will not be offended, for they hated the Lord also (John 15:18). When you are persecuted, you should not be offended (Matthew 11:6), but rather, rejoice because you are counted worthy to suffer shame for His name (Acts 5:41). Remember, John was asked to take the little book from Jesus' hand and eat it—sweet in his mouth, bitter in his belly, and then prophesy again. Meaning: sharing God's truth brings initial joy, but often leads to persecution (Revelation 10:8-11). You can no longer continue in sin, for the seed (nature) of God remains in you, and you have dominion over sin by the power of the Holy Ghost (1 John 3:9).

And because you are under grace and not under the law, that is why you can now obey God indeed (Romans 6:14-18). You are saved not by works, lest any man should boast, but you are saved unto good works (Ephesians 2:8-10). Now, it is He who works in you both to will and to do of His good pleasure (Philippians 2:13). You now fear God, which is the beginning of knowledge (Proverbs 1:7), and because you love Him, you obey Him (John 14:15). Your love for God has made you to seek His wisdom and to know Him by revelation (Ephesians 1:16-17).
BACK TO SENDER
Friends, we're called to be separated from the world.
The first Christians in Antioch were known by how they followed Christ—inside and out (Acts 11:26).
Being born again changes the heart, and that change should be visible in how we live and present ourselves—with modesty and simplicity that honours Him.
“Be not conformed to this world” (Romans 12:2).
Old things are passed away (2 Cor 5:17). Let the world see Christ in us and be drawn to Him. This is for both men and women.

As a Born again christian male which have forsaken worldly fashions such as dreadlocks, earrings, skirts worn by men etc (Deuteronomy 22:5); and you women which have forsaken trousers which are for men, earrings, nose rings, attachments, false eyelashes, make-up, and the exposure of your body to the public, you have embraced modest dressing, and beyond that, your heart is transformed to the image of Christ (Romans 8:29). You can now see how spiritually focused, peaceful, and
BORN AGAIN
INSIDE AND OUT

connected with God you are (Romans 8:6). Just as Jacob commanded his household to put away their strange gods and change their garments, and they dwelt in peace thereafter (Genesis 35:2–5), so also are you now living in the peace of God.

You can no longer be condemned, because you walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit (Romans 8:1-8:4 KJV). You now passionately preach the true gospel, because you have received the Holy Ghost (Acts 1:8). You will not pray through Mary or to departed brethren (“saints”) who also awaits judgment (Hebrews 9:27), for the resurrected Jesus is the one making intercession for you continually (1 Timothy 2:5).

Now you rejoice, for the Holy Ghost dwells in you (Romans 8:14). Yes, you rejoice, because as a chosen vessel, you understand these revelations written for all, especially for the seed of God (Luke 8:10).

You rejoice because God hath given you eternal life freely (2 Corinthians 1:22; Romans 6:23), and He will not take it back, for the gifts and calling of God are without repentance (Romans 11:29). You can now testify that you are saved, and saved forever (John 10:27–29). Your heart is full of joy because the Lord your God and Saviour rejoices over you with singing (Zephaniah 3:17).

Hallelujah! You rejoice because as the bride of Christ—which you are now—you are watching and eagerly waiting for the Bridegroom's imminent second coming (Titus 2:13), and for that great wedding day with Him in Heaven (Revelation 19:6–10). Praise Master Jesus Halleluiah Amen. Shalom.
